name: Angie's Restaurant (Logan, UT) Famous Navajo Taco on Utah Scone (High Risk Warning)
whyItWorks: A Utah diner icon, but a minefield for IBD! Deep-fried oily dough smothered in chili loaded with whole bean skins, onion, and chili powder.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid during active disease and strictures. Opt for an open-face turkey sandwich or plain Utah scone with honey butter.
watchOuts: Whole bean skins and chili spices cause severe gas and intestinal cramping
